title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics, schema mapping, and tool message formatting fixes
author: Samira Khan
description: Motivation: make Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer handle the evolving function/tool-calling semantics from recent OpenAI spec updates. Specifically we map our internal tool schema to OpenAI-style JSON Schema, implement tool_choice semantics (when the model returns a tool_choice decision instead of full tool arguments), and normalize tool message formatting for downstream runners and logs. Summary of changes: 1) add schema_mapper to translate internal ToolSpec -> OpenAI JSON Schema including examples, enums, and nullable handling; 2) update openai_compat handler to accept both 'tool' and 'tool_choice' outcomes from model responses and to synthesize a minimal args payload when only a tool_choice is present; 3) normalize tool messages emitted to the chat stream so that structured tool invocation messages conform to openai/assistant format and include metadata (tool_id, schema_version, inferred_args) in a stable header; 4) add comprehensive unit/integration tests covering ambiguous tool_choice cases, partial argument inference, and streaming path formatting; 5) docs: add migration notes and a compatibility matrix and examples for SDKs. Backwards compatibility: existing callers that expect full tool args are unchanged; flows where the model returns only a tool_choice now get a stable synthesized args object and an opt-in flag allow_tool_choice_passthrough to allow downstream consumers to reject synthesized args if desired. Testing: added 45 unit tests, 8 integration tests, and a small perf check for streaming serialization overhead. Release notes: non-breaking; improves OpenAI compatibility for structured tool calling and fixes several edge cases seen in customer SUP-872. See files changed for details. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] docs updated [x] changelog entry [x] security review (no secrets) [x] canary smoke on staging

release_notes: Improve OpenAI compatibility for function/tool calling: implement canonical JSON Schema mapping for tools, support tool_choice semantics with synthesized args (opt-out available), and normalize tool message formatting for streaming and logs. Non-breaking. See docs/openai-compat/tool-calling.md for migration guidance.
notes_for_release: Non-breaking change: default behavior remains unchanged for callers that receive full tool args.
Opt-in flag allow_tool_choice_passthrough lets consumers reject synthesized args for stricter security/validation.
Docs include examples for Python/TS SDKs and a compatibility matrix vs OpenAI spec versions.
testing_summary: Added 45 unit tests, 8 integration tests and a lightweight streaming perf check. Ran canary on staging cluster with real customer traces for SUP-872 reproduction; no regressions observed.
security_review: no secrets introduced; added input validation for synthesized args and stricter schema enforcement to prevent injection via tool names/enum values
final_comments: Merged after approvals from Avery, Marcus, and Priya. Deployed to staging 2026-03-01 and rolled to prod with canary on 2026-03-01.
Follow-ups: ENG-4045 (add telemetry to track frequency of tool_choice-only responses) and ENG-4078 (optimize synthesized args generator for large schemas).
